notes.title: THE GREY MAN v1.03 BEAMS DOWN
notes.content:
Hello friends,

THE GREY MAN has been updated to version 1.03! This update makes several improvements to player communication for a smoother experience. We did our best with this update to not make it too tutorial-y, while also making several things clearer.

[b]GAME[/b]
[list][*]Several revisions have been made to the intro tutorial text.
[*]Added additional communication prompts.
[/list]

[b]SYSTEM[/b]
[list][*]Made a few small behind-the-scenes adjustments. Sshhhhhh...[/list]

-ATKMTN

notes.title: THE GREY MAN v1.01 HAS LANDED
notes.content:
[b]Okay dude,[/b] it's time for the 30 day patch that your mother has been wondering about and your father already loves.

This update features some minor changes, mostly centered around player communication. We've made it more clear how our human gates work, and also fixed a pretty rare location saving problem that basically teleported the Grey Man around like a real wild animal across full screens, confusing everyone. 

[i]Patch notes below:[/i]

[b]THE GREY MAN - v1.01 PATCH NOTES[/b]

[b]GAME[/b]
[list]
    [*] Fixed a rare bug wherein using the UFO's Fast Travel ability towards the end of the game would cause the Grey Man to appear at the wrong sides of the screen while traveling between certain areas.
    [*] Fixed a bug that was causing the game to trigger a fade out transition when the player approached right-side exits, even if they didn't capture enough humans to advance to the next area.
    [*] One human's behavior has been altered.
[/list]
[b]SYSTEM[/b]
[list]
    [*] Improved messaging for when the user tries to enter an area without having captured the proper amount of humans. Made the 'Humans Required' pop-out display larger so it's easier to read, in addition to adding an error sound.
[/list]
Thanks for playing folks, [i]we'll be here all weekend![/i]

-ATKMTN
